verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found that kimi.com publishes no llms.txt: the URL redirects (HTTP 302) to the SPA root, and the assistant app has no docs site. The only llms.txt found, at platform.kimi.ai, belongs to the Kimi API Open Platform, which the vendor's own product-plans doc describes as a separate product, so it cannot be credited here. The Kimi Code docs show no agent-oriented docs index either.
